name: Ayumi Ryo
source:
Ryo is a talkative boy, especially when art is involved. Generally, he has a bright spirit that enlivens the days of everyone around him, but sometimes, he loses his temper and refuses to come to school. He is [url=https://vndb.org/c45783]Hideaki[/url]’s best friend.

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=144]MangaGamer[/url]]
